ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Bharat Seats Limited (BSL) has received a positive credit rating upgrade from ICRA, with its long-term rating moving to [ICRA]A+(Stable) from [ICRA]A(Stable), reflecting robust operational growth (51% revenue increase in FY2026) and significantly improved debt metrics (Total Debt/OPBITDA reduced to 1.1x from 2.0x). This upgrade enhances BSL's financial flexibility, supports planned capacity expansion with enhanced credit limits, and signals strong business performance, although high customer concentration with MSIL (80% of FY2026 revenue) and a significant portion of future debt-funded capex yet to be sanctioned remain areas for careful observation.
